summary: End-to-end verification of (1) Server-side booking pagination at /api/bookings/my/paged used by /account?tab=orders, and (2) Notification deep links (bell popover + /account?tab=notifications page). critical_code_review_comments: BookingsView fetchPage uses setTimeout/axios without AbortController; rapid typing in bk-search can race and overwrite with stale response (debounce exists but a request cancellation guard would be safer).
notifTarget() in CustomerExtras.jsx matches tabs via regex on link string ('/account?tab=xxx') – consider using URL/URLSearchParams for robustness (handles encoded or hash variants).

In openNotif (CustomerDashboard.jsx line 156), the fallback api.get(`/bookings/${t.bookingId}`) is executed only when the booking isn't in local bookings[] list; good, but on a cold load this may silently miss (.catch(() => '')) – consider a toast if the deep-linked booking cannot be resolved.
